通用與翻譯專用模型的文字表現

同樣是這 29 篇文字，Gemma 4 12B 平均 97.21 分，TranslateGemma 27B 平均 96.54 分。選擇文字模型時也值得看分項，TranslateGemma 27B 的流暢度平均最高。兩款模型使用不同世代、量化格式與提示模板，這次比較的是它們各自的實測配置。

模型設計與公開研究 · 分項排名的統計比較
methods.html:
按不同指標比較，模型排名會改變嗎？

在 29 篇共同文字中，TranslateGemma 27B 的流暢度平均最高，Gemma 4 31B QAT 的術語與台灣用語平均最高，Gemma 4 26B 則在語意與安全、完整性與格式兩項平均最高。

這批文字來自 12 個來源頁面。我們先對每題的五位評審取平均，再以來源為單位，列舉 4,096 種正負號翻轉。整體模型與分項的交互作用達到 p < 0.001。另將每題的七款模型轉為名次，同分取平均名次，探索性檢定也得到 p < 0.001。

四個分項各有 21 組模型配對。這 84 組一起做 Holm 多重比較校正後，均未達 0.05。因此可以說整體排序隨指標而變，無法從某一組的名次互換判定兩款模型有顯著差距。推論假設同一來源內配對差異的符號可交換。圖片只有四張，僅列實測值與描述性名次。

檢定程式（Python、NumPy） · 逐筆評審分數（CSV）

核對評審意見的例子

在 text-06 中，Gemma 4 31B QAT 將 bipolar disorder 譯作「雙相情緒障礙症」。Mistral 評審主張必須改用「情感」。查核發現，健保署與臺大醫院新竹分院的公開資料均使用「雙相情緒障礙症」。檢閱模型頁的扣分理由時，這類術語意見值得與台灣實際用法對照。本次查核僅為個案註解，數據仍採當次評審給分。

健保署資料 · 臺大醫院新竹分院

翻譯與評審的執行設定

翻譯端設定上下文長度 8,192 tokens、輸出上限 4,096 tokens、temperature 0、seed 20261023，並關閉 thinking。本機評審的上下文長度為 32,768 tokens，輸出上限 16,384 tokens，reasoning budget 為 8,192 tokens。

另有 168 組支援雙向比較的配對，各交換 A/B 呈現順序一次。112 組有一致的勝負、7 組兩次皆平手、49 組因順序影響判斷而棄權。另有 12 組 Mistral 圖片配對屬設計上不支援。部分模型組合沒有配對資料，首頁採用逐筆評審分數計算平均。

模型設計與公開研究

已發表的資料本次心理健康素材上的結果
TranslateGemma 以 Gemma 3 為基礎，針對翻譯訓練。Google 公布的是多語測試結果。Gemma 4 12B、26B 與 31B 的文字總分平均都高於 TranslateGemma 27B。四款模型的世代、量化和提示模板不同，單憑這批資料無法分離它們各自的影響。
Gemma 4 26B A4B 採稀疏專家架構，每個 token 只啟用部分參數。在本次硬體與量化配置下，26B 與 31B 的文字平均相差 0.08 分，回應時間中位數分別為 0.69 秒及 2.51 秒。
既有研究顯示，LLM 評審可能受答案順序、長度與自身偏好影響。每次移除一位評審再重算，文字與圖片的前三名次序均維持。上方術語案例也顯示，評審對個別用詞的判斷仍需查證。

index-en.html:
General-purpose and translation-specialized models on text

On the same 29 passages, Gemma 4 12B averaged 97.21 points and TranslateGemma 27B averaged 96.54. TranslateGemma 27B had the highest mean fluency score. The two configurations differ in model generation, quantization and prompt template.

Model design and published research · Statistical comparison of the rubric components
methods-en.html:
Do model rankings change with the scoring criterion?

Across the 29 shared passages, TranslateGemma 27B had the highest mean for fluency. Gemma 4 31B QAT led on terminology and Taiwan usage. Gemma 4 26B had the highest means for meaning and safety, and for completeness and format.

The passages came from 12 source pages. We averaged the five judges within each passage, paired models by source and evaluated all 4,096 sign flips. The overall model-by-criterion interaction had p < 0.001. An exploratory analysis ranked the seven models on each passage, assigned ties their average rank and also gave p < 0.001.

There are 21 model pairs for each of the four criteria. After Holm correction across all 84 comparisons, none reached 0.05. The overall ranking pattern varies across criteria, but a change of place for a particular pair does not establish a significant difference. The test assumes the sign of each paired source-level difference is exchangeable under the null. We report descriptive scores and ranks for the four images.

Statistical analysis code (Python and NumPy) · Individual judge scores (CSV)

Checking a terminology comment

In text-06, Gemma 4 31B QAT translated bipolar disorder as 雙相情緒障礙症. Mistral argued that 情緒 should be replaced with 情感. Taiwan’s National Health Insurance Administration and National Taiwan University Hospital’s Hsinchu Branch both use 雙相情緒障礙症. This check documents local usage for one example. The reported score is the one the judge originally gave.

Taiwan National Health Insurance Administration · National Taiwan University Hospital, Hsinchu

Translation and judge settings

Translation used an 8,192-token context, a 4,096-token output limit, temperature 0, seed 20261023 and thinking disabled. The local judges used a 32,768-token context, a 16,384-token output limit and an 8,192-token reasoning budget.

In a separate test, the judges compared 168 supported pairs twice with the answer order reversed. Both orders produced the same winner for 112 pairs and a tie for seven. The other 49 pairs were set aside because the preference changed with the order. Mistral did not support another 12 image pairs. Only some model pairs were tested this way. The homepage uses the individual rubric ratings.

Model design and published research

Published evidenceWhat this domain-specific run measured
TranslateGemma was trained specifically for translation on a Gemma 3 base. Google reported results from multilingual testing.Gemma 4 12B, 26B and 31B all had higher mean text totals than TranslateGemma 27B. Model generation, quantization and prompt template varied together across these configurations.
Gemma 4 26B A4B uses a mixture of experts and activates a subset of its parameters per token.On this hardware and quantization setup, the text means for 26B and 31B differed by 0.08 points. Median response times were 0.69 s and 2.51 s respectively.
Research on LLM judges describes biases involving answer order, length and the judge’s own preferences.When we removed one judge at a time, the top three stayed in the same order within each track. The terminology example above shows why individual judgements still warrant checking.
